_comment: Registry for project-boundary-check.py. Copy to project-boundaries.json and
adapt — that file is git-ignored because it contains YOUR machine paths.
root:    the project's working directory. A project without one has its work
done elsewhere, and its memory ends up in a foreign repo. That is the
failure this registry exists to catch, so a missing root is an error.
markers: 3-8 terms only this project would use — device names, codenames,
domain nouns. Not generic words: 'server', 'script', 'config' would
match everything and the check would cry wolf until it is ignored.
